card.name: Comma after profound sedation warning
card.fires_on: The comma right after "profound sedation" in the boxed warning on benzodiazepines and opioids, before "respiratory depression, coma, and death". Weaker hits on a few other fixed warning phrases.

modes.label: Sedation list comma
modes.description: The comma after "profound sedation" in the opioid-benzodiazepine warning.
modes.example: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids may result in profound sedation<<,>> respiratory depression, coma, and death.

modes.label: Other warning phrases
modes.description: Odd single positions in other fixed warnings, such as the end of "organophosphorus" or "women" in NSAID pregnancy text.
modes.example: Avoid use of NSAIDs in<< women>> at about 30 weeks gestation

card.plain: It marks the comma in the standard warning that sedation, breathing depression, coma and death can follow combined opioid and benzodiazepine use.
